description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Remove  "Mysore Dhal" and "Canned Fish" From Order No. 61 Published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2167/09 on 17.03.2020
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under Section 20(5) of the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It specifically removes "Mysore Dhal" and "Canned Fish" from a previous order, making it a regulatory action that modifies existing regulations. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
